description_en: Lists the VPC peering connections for a gateway's private network endpoint
description_zh: 获取网关内网访问端点跨VPC连接列表
kebab_example: aliyun eas list-gateway-intranet-linked-vpc-peer --cluster-id cn-wulanchabu --gateway-id gw-1uhcqmsc7x22000000 --vpc-id vpc-2zetuli9ws0qgjd000000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListGatewayIntranetLinkedVpcPeer

parameters.description_en: The region where the private gateway is located.
parameters.help_en: The region where the private gateway is located
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.description_en: The ID of the private gateway. For more information, see [ListGateway](~~2841911~~).
parameters.description_zh: 私有网关ID。如何获取私有网关ID，请参见[ListGateway](~~2841911~~)。
parameters.help_en: The ID of the private gateway. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2841911.html
parameters.help_zh: 私有网关ID。如何获取私有网关ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2841911.html
parameters.name: gateway_id

parameters.description_en:
The ID of the attached virtual private cloud (VPC). For more information, see [ListGatewayIntranetLinkedVpc](~~2621223~~).

- Specify a VPC ID to query only the VPC peers for that VPC.

- If you do not specify a VPC ID, all VPC peers are returned.
parameters.description_zh:
绑定的专有网络ID，如何查询专有网络ID，请参见[ListGatewayIntranetLinkedVpc](~~2621223~~)。
- 配置专有网络ID，仅查询该VPC ID对应的VPC Peers。
- 不配置专有网络ID，则查询全部VPC Peers。
